# ymfm OPN

The OPN, ADPCM and SSG sources are unchanged from [aaronsgiles/ymfm](https://github.com/aaronsgiles/ymfm/tree/81aec25ccbb98f4873a255f7551ac4dadac59b4a) at commit `81aec25ccbb98f4873a255f7551ac4dadac59b4a`. The Daytona target uses the YM3438 implementation. The BSD 3-Clause notice is in [LICENSE](LICENSE).
